data.value: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?

The port automation memorandum is a proposal that the union local may endorse or oppose. The local's executive board can issue a press release stating its position. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The hard cutoff for the resolution is 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00.
